subject: Re: Aligning demo — added governance & procurement stakeholders need a longer slot
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.c@venturehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Li <sam.li@venturehealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@venturehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning demo — additional governance & procurement stakeholders

Hi Rishi,

Quick update from our side: after the product sync today, our security lead and a couple folks from procurement asked to join the demo next week. They want to see the governance controls, audit logs, and deployment options (VPC/on-prem explanation).

I’m on travel Monday morning PT — I can make late afternoon but Sam and procurement are only available earlier in the day. Can we expand the session to 75–90 minutes and shift to one of the morning windows instead? If needed we can have a separate deep-dive after the main demo but they prefer to see the high-level feature set during the first run.

Appreciate any alternative slots you can offer. Also if you could send a short agenda and a SOC2 evidence checklist ahead of time that would help procurement triage.

Thanks,
Alex Carter
VP Product, Venture Health
alex.c@venturehealth.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.c@venturehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo — additional governance & procurement stakeholders

Alex — thanks for the heads up. Totally understood; when security and procurement join we usually move to a 75–90 minute format so we can cover both product and compliance questions without rushing.

I’ve looped in Marissa (solutions engineer) and Priyom (sales ops) to propose morning slots and share the SOC2 checklist. Quick note: we can show VPC/on-prem patterns at a high level in the main demo and offer a follow-up deep-dive with our infra lead if they want lower-level architecture diagrams.

Proposed windows (PT):
 - Mon Apr 12: 9:00–10:30am (preferred)
 - Tue Apr 13: 10:00–11:30am
 - Wed Apr 14: 8:30–10:00am

If none of these work we can do two back-to-back sessions (main demo + infra breakouts). I’ll attach the agenda & SOC2 checklist in the next email.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | (650) 555-0186

Alex / Rishi — adding Soojin (solutions architect) because she’ll own the VPC/on-prem portion.

Attached is a slimmed demo agenda and our SOC2 checklist (pdf stub). For the agenda I recommend 20–25 minutes product overview, 25–30 minutes governance & security walkthrough (audit logs, key management, VPC patterns), and 20–25 minutes for procurement questions and rollout/pricing discussion. That fits into a 90-min slot.

One logistical ask: if procurement wants to review retention and audit-history retention before the call, could they send any focused questions? Priyom — can you confirm the hosting of the agenda in Drive and create a HubSpot event with the updated duration?

Marissa Cole
